description: MainWearActivity.java is an Android Wear application activity that checks for the presence of a companion phone app via Google Play Services, manages capability listeners, and provides UI to open the app store on the phone if the app is missing.

classes.name: MainWearActivity
classes.description: An Android Wear activity that checks for a remote phone app capability, updates UI accordingly, and can launch the app store on the phone.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability listener and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Sets up capability listener and initiates check for phone app.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Handles capability change events and updates UI.

methods.name: checkIfPhoneHasApp
methods.description: Queries for the capability indicating the phone app presence.

methods.name: verifyNodeAndUpdateUI
methods.description: Updates UI based on whether the phone app is installed.

methods.name: openAppInStoreOnPhone
methods.description: Opens the app store on the phone to install the app, depending on device availability.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects the best node (phone) from a set of nodes.
